exact_plan.orientation_test: Both scalar momenta retain the declared order and principal branch, while d(delta)/du=1 on every Gamma_lambda; the scoped scalar orientation ratio is +1.

fixed_limit_order: At fixed epsilon>0, finite R, and 0<lambda<=1, integrate p_phi_0 and p_phi_1 first with the full Gaussian prefactor and branch.
Remove a symmetric field cutoff Y by the declared entire contour homotopy, proving the regulated full-action equality before any lapse limit.
Pair the fixed-nonzero-x equality with C_c^infinity((-R,0) union (0,R)) lapse tests.
Take epsilon to 0+ at fixed lambda on the two nonzero-lapse arms, where the full Starobinsky action retains good ends.
Take lambda to 0+ on those arm distributions; regulated equality is lambda-independent, so no scalar orientation jump is introduced there.
Test, but do not assume, extension to zero-including C_c^infinity((-R,R)); the pure-q-Gaussian shortcut is inadmissible on shifted arms.
Do not take R to infinity, m to infinity, a varying-a limit, a BFV limit, or an automatic descendant.
